eyebrow: SOC Operations, SIEM & Log Analysis · Chapter 5
subtitle: Lesson 18 · Alert Triage & Investigation Workflow

steps.label: Validate
steps.sub: check the raw data -- does it actually support the alert's claim?

steps.label: Scope
steps.sub: what else is touched -- other hosts, accounts, systems?

steps.label: Escalate (if needed)
steps.sub: hand to Tier 2 when the criteria below are met

code:
Alert: "suspicious login -- new geographic location"

Raw auth log check:
  Login occurred:      YES, matches time/IP/location
  MFA result:          passed on first prompt (not after failures)

Scoping check:
  Other accounts from same IP range:   NONE
  Follow-on activity:                  accessed a file share
                                        never touched before

-> validated + scoped -> escalate
caption: The original alert never mentioned the file-share access -- only scoping found it.

steps.label: Confirmed malicious
steps.sub: needs a response beyond Tier 1's authority

steps.label: Scope unclear
steps.sub: the spread can't be fully determined with Tier 1's access

subtitle: Documenting what you found so the next person doesn't start from zero.
